finding: No public point cloud of a complete residential light-frame house (exposed 2x4 stud walls) was found. Fewer than five true wood-frame house clouds. Ranks 3-5 are closer shells or mixed assemblies and rank lower for that reason.
criteria: Closest to a residential wood-frame stage
Labeled studs or beams when they exist

ranked.name: IntCDC timber building scans
ranked.why: Timber structures of 23 building projects, scanned immediately after assembly and alignment. Closest public wood building frame. Not documented as light-frame houses.
ranked.approximate_size: 96 LAS files summing to about 223 GB on the DaRUS listing fetched 2026-09-23. Examples: 2020-KW23.las about 1.9 GB, 2020-KW27.las about 4.2 GB.
ranked.density: Point spacing not stated on the dataset page.
ranked.labels: Whole-cloud semantic stud labels not stated. One example evaluation (2022-KW15, beam axis 4).
ranked.gaps: Heavy timber and some concrete columns, not 2x4 stud walls. Open3D does not read LAS. Occupancy not stated as single-family houses.
ranked.image_note: Official DaRUS point-cloud GIF for 2020-KW27_additonal (timber columns).

ranked.name: WFC-Dataset
ranked.license: Not stated. GitHub README License heading is empty (2026-09-23).
ranked.why: Only public real 2x4 wood-stud point clouds, with a manual 6D pose. Not a house.
ranked.density: 2208x1242. README: about 9x denser than 640x480 sets. Points per cloud unknown.
ranked.labels: Manual 6D pose per sample. Not semantic wall labels.
ranked.gaps: Single stud in controlled lighting. No wall, plates, or jobsite.
ranked.image_note: README assets/labeling_gui.jpeg. Caption in the README: RGB-D point cloud, OBJ, and alignment GUI.

ranked.name: RefSite3D
ranked.why: Real assembly that includes timber (progress state PM2; timber-component benchmark split). PLY and per-point labels. Modular demonstrator, not a house.
ranked.sensor: RIEGL VZ-400i and Leica RTC360 TLS; also iPhone X photogrammetry and Luma NeRF
ranked.approximate_size: RefSite3D_v1.0.0.zip 2.2 GB (2172793209 bytes on the Zenodo API).
ranked.labels: Scene classes: environment, ground, target. Object-verification JSON can reference an IfcBeam synthetic cloud. No stud class.
ranked.gaps: Concrete, timber, and steel module, not a 2x4 house. Some scenes are not TLS. No point-cloud gallery on Zenodo.
ranked.image_note: Limited. Crop of Figure 5 in public TARGET-X D5.3. Photograph of the ReStage structure, not a PLY render.

ranked.name: Rohbau3D
ranked.license: CC BY 4.0 (Open Data UniBw M record at the data DOI, checked 2026-09-23). Paper is also CC BY 4.0.
ranked.why: Best labeled residential shell: 504 TLS scans, 14 sites, six residential apartment blocks at shell or renovation. Not wood studs.
ranked.formats: NumPy feature arrays and panoramas. Not a single PLY.
ranked.approximate_size: Mean about 2.34e7 points per scan. Total archive bytes not stated in the paper. Subsample index caps a cloud at 15 million points.
ranked.density: Mean surface density 31.7 points per cm^2 (std. dev. 15.4), 10 cm neighborhood, from the Scientific Data paper.
ranked.labels: Point-wise semantic class (17 foreground + background) and instance ids. Class names below are third-party.
ranked.gaps: Concrete, brick, and drywall, not 2x4. No stud class in the third-party list. Scans are not in one site frame. Open3D needs a PointCloud built from coord.npy.
ranked.image_note: img/compendium_example.jpg from the official Rohbau3D GitHub repository, resized.

ranked.name: ConSLAM
ranked.license: GitHub LICENCE.txt: academic use only, University of Cambridge, 2023. A separate cloud-download license was not found on the README.
ranked.why: Repeated scans of one construction floor in a London redevelopment that includes a residential scheme, with Leica RTC360 ground-truth PLY. Not wood frame, so it ranks last.
ranked.sensor: Handheld Velodyne VLP-16, Alvium U-319c RGB, NIR, IMU. Ground truth: Leica RTC360.
ranked.formats: groundtruth_scan.ply plus ROS bags, images, and poses
ranked.approximate_size: Unknown. Four sequences. README: sequence 1 bag is faulty.
ranked.density: Not stated in the sections read.
ranked.labels: Poses for SLAM. No semantic stud or beam labels.
ranked.gaps: Mixed-use concrete construction, not exposed studs. Share link may rot. Academic-use code terms.
ranked.image_note: media/leica.jpg from the ConSLAM README hardware row. Not a separate export of groundtruth_scan.ply.
